backup.production_rule: Four new functions (telegram_staff_actor_v1, telegram_guest_candidates_v1, telegram_save_guest_details_v1, telegram_save_guest_companion_v1). No table, column, policy, grant-on-existing-object or data change; nothing is dropped. restore_point and verified_at are placeholders: take a fresh backup, then fill both. Take a fresh backup if the one named is more than an hour old at apply time.

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: Redeploy the previous telegram-expense first (it stops calling the new RPCs), then apply supabase/rollbacks/20261002_telegram_guest_intake.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh: it drops the four functions. Rows they already wrote (guest_profile_details, guest_companions, history, objects in guest-id-photos) are ordinary audited rows and stay.

feature_flags.name: telegram_expense_deploy
feature_flags.required_state: Apply this release BEFORE deploying telegram-expense with the /guest flow. Until the function is deployed nothing calls the new RPCs and nothing changes for staff. A deployed telegram-expense without this release answers /guest with a plain "not available yet" message (the RPC is reported missing).
